services.name: General Dental Consultation
services.shortDescription: Comprehensive dental checkup, bite assessment, and personalized treatment plan.
services.fullDescription: Our foundational consultation includes thorough visual inspection of teeth, gums, and oral soft tissues, gentle screening for cavities, and clear guidance on preventive oral health.
services.feeNotice: Standard in-clinic consultation fee applies. Transparent pricing provided during visit.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning & Ultrasonic Scaling
services.shortDescription: Gentle ultrasonic plaque and tartar removal for healthy gums and fresh breath.
services.fullDescription: Professional ultrasonic prophylaxis clears stubborn calculus and surface staining around gumlines without damaging tooth enamel. Recommended every 6 months.
services.feeNotice: Transparent fee discussed based on calculus grade.

services.name: Cavity Treatment & Composite Fillings
services.shortDescription: Tooth-colored durable aesthetic restorations to protect decaying or chipped teeth.
services.fullDescription: High-strength shade-matched composite resins seamlessly bond to your natural tooth structure, sealing dental decay while preserving natural tooth aesthetics.
services.feeNotice: Pricing determined by number of surfaces restored.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
services.shortDescription: Painless modern root canal therapy to relieve severe tooth pain and preserve your tooth.
services.fullDescription: Advanced rotary endodontic treatment cleans and seals infected pulp tissue under precision local anesthesia, preventing extraction and restoring chewing comfort.
services.feeNotice: Fee varies by anterior, premolar, or molar anatomy.

services.name: Professional Teeth Whitening
services.shortDescription: Safe, dentist-supervised enamel brightening for a radiant, confident smile.
services.fullDescription: Clinical-grade peroxide brightening systems safely lift deep tea, coffee, and age-related tooth discoloration with minimal sensitivity.
services.feeNotice: In-clinic chairside packages communicated upon evaluation.

services.name: Dental Crowns & Bridges
services.shortDescription: Custom ceramic and zirconia crowns to restore structural strength and aesthetics.
services.fullDescription: Precision digital impressions and durable biocompatible zirconia or porcelain-fused restorations that recreate original anatomy and bite balance.
services.feeNotice: Tiered options according to material (Zirconia, E-Max, PFM).

services.name: Dental Implants Consultation
services.shortDescription: Permanent titanium fixture assessment for missing teeth replacement.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive implant planning using 3D bone evaluation, digital surgical planning, and long-term functional stability assessment.
services.feeNotice: Detailed surgical and prosthetic estimate provided post-scan.

services.name: Wisdom Tooth & Oral Surgery Consultation
services.shortDescription: Evaluation for impacted wisdom teeth, persistent pain, and surgical removal.
services.fullDescription: Clinical and radiographic assessment of third molar position, nerve proximity, and surgical planning for atraumatic extraction.
services.feeNotice: Categorized according to impaction angle and complexity.

services.name: Orthodontics & Clear Aligners Evaluation
services.shortDescription: Teeth straightening, bite alignment, and modern invisible aligner planning.
services.fullDescription: Digital smile assessment for crowding, gaps, and malocclusion with transparent aligners and modern aesthetic brackets.

services.name: Pediatric Dental Care
services.shortDescription: Gentle, reassuring dental examinations and preventive sealants for children.
services.fullDescription: Friendly, anxiety-free dental visits focused on fluoride application, cavity prevention, pit and fissure sealants, and lifelong oral habits.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment online at Smile Architect Dental Clinic?
faqs.answer: Choose your desired service, select your preferred dentist (or any available dentist), pick a suitable date and available time slot, enter your basic contact details, and submit. You will receive an immediate booking reference number.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking if my plans change?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can manage your appointment online anytime using your booking reference and mobile number, or contact us directly via phone (+91 90368 27916) or WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What are the clinic opening hours in Hebbal 2nd Stage, Mysuru?
faqs.answer: Monday to Saturday: Morning session 10:00 AM – 1:30 PM, Evening session 5:00 PM – 8:30 PM. Sunday: Morning session 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM (by prior appointment).

faqs.question: How are treatment fees and consultation charges communicated?
faqs.answer: We maintain strict transparency. Consultation fees and personalized treatment plans are explained clearly after a direct clinical examination, with zero surprise charges or unverified quotes.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic located and is parking available?
faqs.answer: We are located at 850/S, 25th Cross Road, Manchegowdana Koppalu, Sankranthi Circle, Hebbal 2nd Stage, Mysuru (Landmark: near Sankranthi Circle). Street parking for two-wheelers and four-wheelers is readily accessible.

faqs.question: What hygiene and sterilization protocols are followed?
faqs.answer: We adhere to multi-stage autoclave sterilization, medical-grade ultrasonic cleaners, individually packaged sterile instrument pouches opened in front of the patient, and hospital-grade surface disinfection between visits.
